name: dogma
description: Dogma bioinformatics IDE monorepo: web graph workspace, VS Code/Cursor extension, and local sidecar.

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; python -m uvicorn quration.api.server:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.install:all: npm run install:python && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:dogma:editors: npm run build:dogma-extension && code --install-extension dogma-$(node -p "require('./dogma-vscode-extension/package.json').version").vsix --force && cursor --install-extension dogma-$(node -p "require('./dogma-vscode-extension/package.json').version").vsix --force
scripts.test:desktop-smoke: npm run build:frontend && npm --prefix frontend run electron:smoke
scripts.test:dogma-extension: npm --prefix dogma-vscode-extension run check && npm --prefix dogma-vscode-extension test
scripts.test:dogma-service: cd dogma-local-service && python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.test:dogma: npm run test:dogma-extension && npm run test:dogma-service && npm run test:dogma-skill
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:electron && npm run test:dogma
scripts.check:dogma: npm run check:public-safety && npm run check:dogma-rename && npm run test:dogma
scripts.check:all: npm run check:public-safety && npm run check:dogma-rename && npm test && npm run build:frontend

author: Manu Arrojwala
